Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride

Norman, OK · Downtown Norman

Beginner friendly

Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride is a road and social group ride in Norman, OK. It meets every Wednesday, 6:30 pm (March–November), starting at Lazy Circles Brewing. Pace: three groups: 11, 14 and 16 mph.

About the Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride group ride

Norman's entry-level weeknight ride. Three groups leave the brewery at 11, 14 and 16 mph and are back in about an hour. Supported by the Bicycle League of Norman, Phat Tire, Scissortail Cycles and Buchanan Bicycles. Does not run in rain.
